hook: Google's new robot brain folds laundry, serves pastries and *sorts car parts*
caption:
Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable model for controlling robots so far.
In a pilot at Mercedes-Benz plants in Hungary and Germany, Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid sorted car parts into trays with a 96% success rate.
Google says it beats its earlier robot models by 30% to 100% on tested tasks and finishes them 20% to 30% faster.
